showColorSwatches.description: Show or hide the color swatches next to project names in the task list

showCompletionCheckmarks.description: Show or hide the green checkmarks next to completed tasks in the task list

taskBarHeight.description: Height of task bars in pixels

projectBarHeight.description: Height of project summary bars in pixels

rowPadding.description: Vertical space above and below each bar within its row (pixels)

projectBarCornerRadius.description: Corner radius of project/summary bars in pixels

taskBarCornerRadius.description: Corner radius of task bars in pixels

showTaskLabels.description: Show or hide the task name labels that appear to the right of each bar

showProgressLabels.description: Show the actual progress percentage before each data label (e.g. "50% · Task name"). Shown when a Progress field is added.

showProjectDuration.description: Show the duration in days to the right of each top-level project bar.

defaultZoomPreset.description: The zoom level applied when the report loads

defaultScrollPosition.description: The horizontal position of the timeline when the report loads

zeroDurationAsMilestone.description: Render tasks whose start and end dates are equal as milestone markers instead of bars

taskMilestoneSymbol.description: Marker shape for tasks whose start and end dates are equal

hideOutsideBar.description: Hide milestone markers that fall outside their task bars

markerSize.description: Size of milestone markers as a percentage of task bar height

symbol.description: Marker shape for this milestone column

show.description: Show or hide the Today line on the timeline

style.description: Line style for the Today line

show.description: Show or hide dependency arrows between tasks

lineStyle.description: Line style for the dependency arrows

lineWidth.description: Width of the dependency arrows in pixels

position.description: Where the legend appears around the chart

showTitle.description: Show or hide the legend title

titleText.description: Override the automatic legend title text

dataColors.description: Customize colors for each top-level category

defaultColor.description: Color used when no legend data is provided or for parent tasks with mixed children
